clips.title: The story
paras: At Raynewood Retreat, Ordanus' Head is claimed as proof that Keeper Ordanus has fallen. Blood elf magi Braelyn Firehand seeks it in Ashenvale.

Keeper Ordanus was an ancient keeper of the grove and one of Cenarius's elder sons. Braelyn Firehand climbed the heights of Stonetalon Mountains on her master's orders, seeking to end the druids' stifling of magic at the peak and take vengeance on Ordanus. Before she could strike, the keeper was spirited away to the heart of Ashenvale. Braelyn used arcane scrying to peer through the forest canopy and found his sanctuary in the boughs of Raynewood Retreat. She demanded his severed head as proof that the wild demigod's arrogance had been answered.
